question: What was the new motto of Lokpal of India adopted by the full bench of Lokpal in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Empower Citizens, Expose Corruption**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The new motto of the **Lokpal of India**, adopted by the full bench in **June 2025**, is "**Empower Citizens, Expose Corruption**."
 
• This motto reflects the Lokpal's commitment to **strengthening public participation** in governance and ensuring **transparency and accountability** in the fight against corruption.
 
• The motto emphasizes the dual role of the Lokpal: **empowering ordinary citizens** by addressing their grievances and **exposing corrupt practices** in public offices.
 
• The adoption of this motto aligns with the Lokpal's broader objective under the **Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013**, which aims to combat corruption among public functionaries.
 
• By adopting this motto, the Lokpal aims to establish itself as a **citizen-centric institution**, encouraging whistleblowing and ensuring justice for victims of corruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013:**

 
 
• The **Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act** was enacted in **2013** to establish the Lokpal at the central level and Lokayuktas at the state level for investigating cases of corruption against public servants.
 
• The Lokpal consists of a **chairperson** and up to **eight members**, half of whom must be judicial members and at least 50% from SC/ST/OBC, minorities, or women.
 
• The jurisdiction of the Lokpal covers the **Prime Minister (with specific safeguards), ministers, Members of Parliament, and group A, B, C, and D officers and officials** of the central government.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Lokpal:**
 
 
• The Lokpal is mandated to ensure **effective action against corruption** in public offices, thereby fostering **good governance**.
 
• The institution works towards **strengthening accountability** mechanisms and addressing citizens' grievances related to corruption.
 
 
 
• **Features of the Motto:**
 
 
• "**Empower Citizens**": This part of the motto focuses on enabling citizens to actively participate in governance and hold public officials accountable.
 
• "**Expose Corruption**": This emphasizes the Lokpal's role in uncovering and addressing corrupt practices, ensuring transparency and fairness in administrative processes.
 
 
 
• **Other Anti-Corruption Mechanisms in India:**
 
 
• **Central Vigilance Commission (CVC):** Established to address corruption in central government organizations.
 
• **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI):** Investigates high-profile corruption cases and economic offenses.
 
• **Whistleblowers Protection Act, 2014:** Provides a mechanism to protect individuals who expose corruption or misuse of power by public servants.
